title: Laundering Cotton Item
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 5 Agriculture; not yet checked by a CBC Agriculture teacher; not loaded by the live tutor
notes: Use a handkerchief or a cotton T-shirt. A charcoal iron is used only by the teacher; children press with a cool flat iron if one is safe and supervised.

skills.key_step: The child orders the steps of laundering cotton: sort, mend, soak, wash (whites first), rinse well, dry, iron, fold and store.

floor.prerequisite: Knows cleaning jobs are done in order.
floor.question: Which comes first: dusting or mopping?

representations: a basin, soap and a cotton item
steps: Rinse until the water is clear.

board.do: Write the cards: rinse, wash, dry.

misconceptions.ask: Which comes first in laundering clothes?
misconceptions.repair: Lay out the steps on cards and do a real small wash in that order.

misconceptions.ask: Why wash white and coloured clothes separately?
misconceptions.repair: Soak a red cloth with a white one in a basin and look at the water.

misconceptions.ask: What happens if soap is left in clothes?
misconceptions.repair: Feel a rinsed and an unrinsed cloth when dry.

misconceptions.ask: What is the first step in laundering?
misconceptions.repair: Show a small tear that became a big hole after washing.

checks.question: Why rinse until the water is clear?

skills.key_step: The child cares for white and fast-coloured cotton: warm or hot water for whites, warm for colours, gentle squeezing, whites dried in the sun and colours inside out in shade, ironed while slightly damp with a hot iron.
representations: a drying line in sun and shade
steps: Dry whites in sun, colours in shade, inside out.

board.do: Draw a coloured shirt on a line in strong sun.
Ask what happens to the colour over many weeks.

misconceptions.ask: What is best for washing coloured cotton?
misconceptions.repair: Wash two cloths of the same colour, one in cool and one in hot water, and look at the water.

listen_for: Face out in the hot sun
misconceptions.ask: How should coloured clothes be dried?
misconceptions.repair: Compare an old shirt dried face out in the sun for a term with a shirt dried in the shade.

listen_for: With a cool iron when soaking wet
misconceptions.repair: Iron two pieces of cotton, one dripping and one a little damp, with a teacher.

listen_for: Twist it as hard as possible
misconceptions.ask: How should a coloured cotton shirt be squeezed after rinsing?
misconceptions.repair: Compare a shirt wrung hard (creased, stretched) with one squeezed gently.

checks.question: Where should white cotton be dried?
When is cotton easiest to iron?
